validationQueue.title: pt-webgpu CWBVH opt-in parity and default-promotion evidence
validationQueue.remaining: Committed proof pins opt-in CWBVH closest-hit/any-hit WGSL oracle parity, renderer binary-vs-CWBVH pixel parity, multi-root remapping, dzn full-tier simple/complex parity shards, and a broader dzn material/glTF workload shard. Default promotion is still blocked: the fixed per-shard dzn status artifacts are single-sample snapshots and uniformly slower for CWBVH across the simple, complex, material-lobe, material-lobe-map, and glTF material-sweep shards. `npm run cwbvh-default-promotion-repeats -- --repeats=5 --warmup=1 --dzn-timeout-ms=900000` now checkpoints summary and raw repeat records after every completed shard and carries a 900s dzn shard timeout sized to the committed broader CWBVH lane; the committed repeat artifact is a completed five-sample warmup-discarded dzn campaign across all workloads. It remains classification=uniform-slower with promotion.defaultReady=false: binary, complex, material-lobe, and glTF medians are slower, while one material-lobe-map fast outlier is not enough for default promotion. A browser/real-adapter throughput A/B with multiple warmup-discarded repeats per workload remains required before making CWBVH the default traversal.

futureContractRows.title: real displacement/microdisplacement
futureContractRows.currentContract: CPU-readable vertex displacement is consumed approximately; no tessellation or microgeometry synthesis is promised.

includes: no tessellation/microdisplacement is synthesized, so the row is approximate.
displacement rows stay approximate on every backend until microdisplacement is contracted

decisionBlockers: Define public dicing/tessellation controls, error bounds, and displacement bounds.
Specify readable texture residency, generated-normal/tangent policy, BVH rebuild/refit semantics, and backend capability grades.

futureContractRows.title: true transparent layered GI transport
futureContractRows.currentContract: OIT and alpha-aware direct/shadow handling are implemented; transparent surfaces are not full ReSTIR/GI transport vertices.

includes: approximations rather than transparent ReSTIR/GI reservoir participation
keeps fractional alpha-blend surfaces out of ReSTIR primary and reconnection vertices
keeps transparent OIT lighting local instead of coupling it to ReSTIR reservoirs

decisionBlockers: Choose alpha coverage versus physical transmission semantics for reservoir/GI vertices.
Define layered throughput payloads, reuse rules, DDGI/RC participation, and denoiser expectations.

futureContractRows.title: walkaround spectral, thin-film, layered, and volumetric material transport
futureContractRows.currentContract: walkaround-hybrid consumes broad atlas-backed PBR, alpha, direct-light, GI suffix, and receiver-lobe material payloads, but spectralAttenuation, dispersionAbbeNumber, and thinFilmStack/full-layer-stack transport remain unsupported; scatteringCoefficient, scatteringCoefficientRGB, frontLayer, backLayer, and displacement are approximate/diagnostic rather than path-tracer-equivalent. Arbitrary rich glTF assets should route to PT backends unless hosts accept those walkaround approximations.
decisionBlockers: Define what native realtime spectral/dispersion/thin-film/layer-stack transport means for an RGB reservoir backend.
Choose promotion targets for bounded approximations versus routing rich assets to PT backends.

futureContractRows.title: native point and line primitive rendering
futureContractRows.currentContract: glTF POINTS and LINES import through generated mesh fallbacks.
decisionBlockers: Add a first-class core point/line primitive contract.
Define width, caps/joins, hit/intersection semantics, shadows, picking, and backend fidelity grades.

futureContractRows.title: arbitrary multi-UV arrays
futureContractRows.currentContract: Single high TEXCOORD_N lossless remap is implemented; direct core PT backend packers warn/drop texCoord > 1 maps; true arbitrary UV arrays require a new core/backend contract.
decisionBlockers: Extend core primitive geometry and TextureRef contracts beyond uv0/uv1.
Rework shared packers, mutation patches, tangent generation, and backend shader descriptor layouts for arbitrary UV indexing.

futureContractRows.title: native instanced skinned/morphed glTF
futureContractRows.currentContract: Renderable fallback expansion is implemented; native instanced skinned/morphed primitives are a performance/core-contract expansion.

includes: per authored instance so every instance remains renderable under the existing core contract

decisionBlockers: Add a combined instanced-skinned/morphed primitive contract with per-instance pose/morph semantics.
Define GPU/CPU skinning, TLAS/BLAS update, animation-controller, and mutation behavior without exploding memory.

futureContractRows.title: full-path analytic adjoint parity
futureContractRows.currentContract: pt-webgpu supports scoped direct-light path replay for bounded material/emitter domains and finite-difference fallback diagnostics for transport, visibility, displacement geometry, unsupported render regimes, indirect paths, and full-path parity cases.
decisionBlockers: Choose a differentiable transport strategy for visibility, stochastic sampling, multi-bounce, caustics, BDPT/ReSTIR regimes, and environment escape.
Define promotion tests and fallback semantics for full material/path parity beyond the scoped direct-light replay contract.
